224:t_1:169.en:
$$ランカ$$
「...I... I want to go see those ruins...」

224:t_1:170.en:
$$アルト$$
「Go...? $$ランカ$$, you... This isn't a picnic, you know?」

224:t_1:171.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Even if it's dangerous, I want to see it too. What people from long, long ago... from the distant past... left behind to tell us something. With my own eyes.」

224:t_1:172.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Because I have something I want to tell people, too...」

224:t_1:174.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I'll guard $$ランカ$$. ...I request permission, Major $$オズマ$$.」

224:t_1:175.en:
$$オズマ$$
「I've heard what $$ランカ$$ wants. I'm leaving the guard duty to you, $$ブレラ$$, $$アルト$$.」

224:t_1:183.en:
$$マックス$$
「...That concludes our status report.」

224:t_1:184.en:
$$ミリア$$
「The best thing we've gained is confirming that $$ミレーヌ$$ is safe.」

224:t_1:185.en:
$$マックス$$
「I understand how you feel, but $$バトル７$$'s mission is...」

224:t_1:186.en:
$$ミリア$$
「I'll stop mixing the personal with the official here. But if we're that lucky, I'll start to hope for the $$ネオ・ラクス$$ ruins expedition too.」

224:t_1:187.en:
$$ミリア$$
「I'll be waiting for good news.」

224:t_1:188.en:
$$マックス$$
「Understood. We'll do our best on our end too.」

224:t_1:189.en:
$$ミリア$$
「And ask $$ミレーヌ$$ something for me. Whether she's made any progress with Captain $$ガムリン$$.」

224:t_1:191.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「...About now, $c should be reaching the ruins on Planet $$ネオ・ラクス$$.」

224:t_1:192.en:
$$マックス$$
「Is this all right, Chief of Staff? You moved $$バトル７$$ because you wanted to see the ruins yourself, and yet you're waiting here on standby.」

224:t_1:195.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Perhaps it's my nature as a records officer... I find I would rather record what happens there than be a party to the events myself.」

224:t_1:196.en:
$$マックス$$
「And you, of all people, have a feeling that something is going to happen?」

224:t_1:197.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「...Come to think of it, this feeling may have begun the moment they appeared before us through the mystery of the universe.」

224:t_1:198.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「No... What I regret now is having carelessly used a phrase like 'the mystery of the universe' before that.」

224:t_1:199.en:
$$マックス$$
「What do you mean, Chief of Staff?」

224:t_1:200.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「It is all just a feeling...」

224:t_1:201.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「But I cannot help thinking that in this operation, we will encounter something beyond human understanding.」

224:t_2:3.en: ～ Inside the $$プロトカルチャー$$ Ruins ～

224:t_2:4.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「...This is as far as we can go in our machines. From here on, we proceed on foot.」

224:t_2:9.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Don't look away from your fear. Hope lies beyond it.」

224:t_2:11.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I fought on the orders of 《$$グレイス#keyword$$》 $$オコナー$$ to recover my memories of the past...」

224:t_2:12.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「But I learned that what truly matters is not the memories I lost, but what lies beyond them... the future.」

224:t_2:13.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「That's why I was able to fight. Knowing there is hope beyond fear.」

224:t_2:15.en:
$$セツコ$$
「It seems his words gave you something to think about.」

224:t_2:17.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We only went two days without seeing each other, and you seem to have grown.」

224:t_2:18.en:
$n
「...Little by little, I feel like I've started to understand how strong you and $$ランド$$ are.」

224:t_2:19.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm sure you'll get even stronger, $n.」

224:t_2:23.en:
$$アルト$$
「Damn! The ceiling's going to collapse!」

224:t_3:3.en: ～ Inside the $$プロトカルチャー$$ Ruins ～

224:t_3:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$ミレーヌ$$ and Captain $$ガムリン$$ are rescuing $$バサラ$$. I'm sure he'll be fine.」

224:t_3:8.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But it's a dead end. We can't go any farther.」

224:t_3:9.en:
$n
「What do we do? Blow the door open?」

224:t_3:10.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「No... This must be the same as the ruins on $$惑星ラクス$$.」

224:t_3:12.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Now, $$ランカ$$... You are the one who opens the door.」

224:t_3:14.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「This door is a proof of peace... In other words, it apparently responds to someone with the blood of different races.」

224:t_3:15.en:
$$アルト$$
「I see...! $$ランカ$$ has $$ゼントラーディ$$ blood...!」

224:t_3:17.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「...I don't know whether that is a proof of peace.」

224:t_3:18.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「But, $$ランカ$$... $$誰か$$ wanted us, and that is why we were born into this world.」

224:t_3:20.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I'm sure there were all sorts of obstacles along the way. But we are here... That was someone's hope.」

224:t_3:24.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I'm not just someone who gets protected. I can give someone hope too...」

ネオ・ラクス.evidence: Milia/Exsedol name the planet explored in stage 2032; sibling of the glossary's 惑星ラクス = Planet Lux (Protoculture ruins planet). Written 'Planet $$ネオ・ラクス$$' for 惑星ネオ・ラクス.

オコナー.evidence: Surname of グレイス・オコナー = Grace O'Connor (glossary); the source splits the link as 《グレイス》・オコナー so the surname needs its own token.

kept_omissions: 224:t_1:197: 彼等 'they' left as bare 'they' (referent not settled by the slice; Exsedol speaks of whoever appeared 'through the mystery of the universe')
224:t_1:190: Max's trailing 「女親というものは…」 kept unfinished ('Honestly, mothers...')
224:t_2:15: Setsuko's 'あの人' = Brera by scene (written 'his words'; gender from glossary)
uncertain: 参謀 = 'Chief of Staff' (Exsedol; 記録参謀 = 'records officer'); no glossary/rank-table entry
新 names proposed: ネオ・ラクス = Neo Lux (written 'Planet $$ネオ・ラクス$$' for 惑星ネオ・ラクス); オコナー = O'Connor as own token because source links only 《グレイス》
t_1:197-198: 彼等 referent unclear and 'mystery of the universe' reference is likely to an earlier scene (stage 2031?)
t_2:17: 2日間 read as two days Setsuko and Hibiki went without meeting
t_2:20-21: Suzune's 予感ですか？ and Setsuko's これは確信です read as Setsuko's confident prediction about Hibiki growing stronger
